title: Josephus problem
prompt: Some people stand in a circle, numbered 1 to n. Counting starts at person 1, who counts as 1; the person who counts as k leaves the circle, and counting continues with the next person still in the circle, who counts as 1 again. This repeats until only one person is left. For example, with n = 5 and k = 2 the people leave in the order 2, 4, 1, 5 and person 3 is left. Print the number of the last person left for each of these cases, one per line, in this order: n = 7 with k = 3, n = 41 with k = 3, n = 10 with k = 2.
